items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He also became the man who did Shaft for Isaac Hayes.

ctx.x: Tom McIntosh was the arranger for the commercial things that we did. He kept saying to me – he said, “I’ve seen you before.” He said, “I know you from somewhere.” I said, “Maybe you know my father.” He said, “What’s your father’s name?” I said, “His name was Charles Evans.” He said, “No.” He said, “Wait a minute. Carlos,” because that’s what they called him in the army. “Carlos.” He said, “That’s right. You look just like him.” He said, “Come over here,” and we became the best of friends and still are today.
